item.title: Grist for the mill: the slow death of New Zealand’s industry towns
item.description: On June 30, 2025, paper machine 6 at Kinleith Mill in Tokoroa rolled its final reel of paper, marking the end of 70 years of manufacturing and the loss of more than 150 jobs. Anna Rankin was there to speak to the workers who leave behind decades of experience in an industry town determined to survive. Summer read – originally published August 25 2025. The event’s mastermind tells Rachel Judkins how he did it. Summer read – originally published March 5 2025. Rakiura, Stewart Island. Famous for its geographical isolation, dark skies and rare birds. item.title: ‘The trail was haunting me’: Northbound by Naomi Arnold, reviewed
item.description: Liv Sisson reads the roller coaster that is Naomi Arnold’s epic account of walking Te Araroa. Summer read – originally published April 8 2025. Every fucking inch.
